description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
